claims.sectionKey: Costumava + infinitivo en el corpus estudiado
claims.summary: Oliveira (2010) analyzes Brazilian Portuguese sentences from a corpus compiled from Internet search results and finds that costumava + infinitive with activity verbs can express repetition/habit; in one example the periphrasis itself supplies the repetitive interpretation, while other sentences include temporal or frequency adjuncts.
